Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Creek car slides off left through 17.2 s, then at 17.4 s a hard cut to a residential street with two low houses, a tree, green street signs, a white car on asphalt with brown water pooled only at the left half. Water is shallow relative to the wheels. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater appears from 17.6 s. Lower third is plain sidewalk.
